Test Scenario: Verify access to the employee list
Preconditions: User is logged in with permission to access PIM
Test Steps: 1. Open the PIM module. 2. Open the employee list.
Expected Result: The employee list page opens successfully.

Preconditions: User is on the employee list page
Test Steps: 1. Review the employee list. 2. Review the displayed columns and record information.
Expected Result: Employee records and relevant columns are displayed clearly without unexpected errors.

Test Scenario: Search for an employee by valid data
Preconditions: User is on the employee list page and a known employee record exists
Test Steps: 1. Enter a known employee value in an available search field. 2. Select Search.
Expected Result: The matching employee record is displayed.

Test Scenario: Search for an employee with invalid data
Preconditions: User is on the employee list page
Test Steps: 1. Enter a value that does not match an employee. 2. Select Search.
Expected Result: The system displays no matching records or an equivalent empty-result response.

Preconditions: User is on the employee list page
Test Steps: 1. Select an available employee filter. 2. Provide valid filter criteria. 3. Select Search.
Expected Result: The employee list displays records matching the selected criteria.

Preconditions: User is on the employee list page with search or filter criteria applied
Test Steps: 1. Enter search or filter criteria. 2. Select Reset.
Expected Result: The search and filter fields are cleared and the default employee list is restored.

Test Scenario: Add an employee with valid data
Preconditions: User is logged in with permission to add employees
Test Steps: 1. Open the PIM module. 2. Select Add Employee. 3. Enter valid employee information. 4. Save the employee.
Expected Result: The employee is saved successfully and the new employee information is displayed or searchable.

Test Scenario: Add an employee with missing mandatory data
Preconditions: User is on the Add Employee page
Test Steps: 1. Leave one or more mandatory fields empty. 2. Select Save.
Expected Result: The employee is not saved and required-field validation is displayed for the missing fields.

Test Scenario: Add an employee with invalid data
Preconditions: User is on the Add Employee page
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid data in a field that has validation rules. 2. Select Save.
Expected Result: The invalid data is rejected or an appropriate validation message is displayed.

Preconditions: User is on the Add Employee or employee-edit page
Test Steps: 1. Review the employee identifier field. 2. Enter or modify the identifier where permitted. 3. Save the record.
Test Data: Valid and duplicate employee identifier values
Expected Result: The identifier follows the application's required format and duplicate values are handled appropriately.

Test Scenario: Edit employee information with valid data
Preconditions: An existing employee record is available and editable
Test Steps: 1. Open an employee record. 2. Select Edit if required. 3. Update an editable field with valid data. 4. Save.
Expected Result: The employee information is updated successfully.

Test Scenario: Edit employee information with invalid data
Preconditions: An existing employee record is available and editable
Test Steps: 1. Open an employee record. 2. Enter invalid data in an editable field. 3. Save.
Expected Result: The invalid update is prevented or an appropriate validation message is displayed.

Preconditions: An existing employee record is available and the demo user has delete permission
Test Steps: 1. Open the employee list. 2. Select an employee record. 3. Select Delete. 4. Confirm the deletion.
Test Data: Test employee record suitable for deletion
Expected Result: The employee is deleted after confirmation and no longer appears in the employee list.

Test Scenario: Cancel an employee create or edit action
Preconditions: User is on an employee create or edit page
Test Steps: 1. Enter or change employee information. 2. Select Cancel or navigate away without saving. 3. Reopen the employee record if applicable.
Expected Result: The unsaved changes are not persisted.

Preconditions: An existing employee record is available and the delete confirmation is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Select Delete for an employee. 2. Cancel or dismiss the confirmation.
Expected Result: The employee is not deleted and remains available in the employee list.

Preconditions: An employee record has been saved successfully
Test Steps: 1. Navigate away from the employee record. 2. Refresh or reopen the employee list. 3. Search for the employee.
Expected Result: The saved employee information remains available and unchanged after navigation or refresh.
